description: Use this when the user wants their German CV (Lebenslauf) laid out as a real, finished document. Pass only facts the user actually gave you. Returns an interactive preview card where the user can switch template and colour, download a watermarked PDF, or continue in the LebenslaufHeld editor. Run vollstaendigkeits_check first if you are unsure whether data is missing. Do not use this for cover letters (use anschreiben_erstellen).
